source.stem: Which statement about polymers is correct?

options.text: Polymers are formed by breaking down monomers.
Polymers can be natural or synthetic.
Polymers contain atoms of only one element.
Polymers have a giant ionic structure.

packed_tags.subject: science
packed_tags.topic: States of matter, particles and water

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: water particles is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Applies when potassium permanganate grains are placed in water and the colour spreads without manual stirring.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: spreading and mixing through the available liquid or gas happens first, and that produces constant particle motion, with faster motion at higher temperature.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when Applies when potassium permanganate grains are placed in water and the colour spreads without manual stirring is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: Particles of liquids and gases are in constant motion; moving water particles spread potassium permanganate through water, moving gas particles spread fragrance through air, and hotter water spreads the colour faster because its particles move faster. constant particle motion, with faster motion at higher temperature -> spreading and mixing through the available liquid or gas The learner predicts spreading of colour or fragrance from constant particle motion and predicts fastest colour spreading in hot water because hotter particles move faster. Colour or fragrance spreads only when someone stirs, blows, or carries it across the space.
